name: @permitzip/bim-pack-architecture
description: MutinyBIM Architecture add-on (namespace architecture, first-party): grids, walls, doors, windows, openings, floors, ceilings, roofs, columns and stairs with their types and parameters, joins, host voids, room bounding, rating rows and the IFC4 mapping. Built only through the add-on contract; the kernel imports nothing from it.
